channel.title: AzRoleWatcher
channel.description: Continuously monitor roles and permissions in Microsoft Entra ID and Azure.

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: a55e9338-b2cb-4a9b-8ee0-5c56842dc830
Display name: Embedding User
Description: Execute embedding operations against registered inference accounts. This role should be assigned to users who need to run embedding generation workloads but do not need to manage the accounts themselves.
Link: https://management.azure.com/a55e9338-b2cb-4a9b-8ee0-5c56842dc830?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: edbce4e0-c70f-4f11-94ea-eb5f338fc09e
Display name: Windows 365 Service Connector Administrator
Description: Provides access to create, read, and update service connectors and attach them to Windows 365 resources.
Link: https://management.azure.com/edbce4e0-c70f-4f11-94ea-eb5f338fc09e?api-version=2022-04-01
